newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Pharmaceuticals sees A$1 bln sales.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Pharmaceuticals sees A$1 bln sales.

text.p: Australian Pharmaceuticals Industries Ltd said on Friday that after seeing the results for the first two months of the year that it expected sales to reach A$1 billion in the year to April 30, 1998.
The company said it was coping with tight margins through new technology that had cut customer credits and improved ordering systems.

Australian Pharmaceuticals posted an operating profit for 1996/97 of A$25.47 million on Thursday on sales of A$855.54 million, up from profits of A$23.12 million and sales of A$743.19 million the previous year.
Shares in Australian Pharmaceuticals, which listed on the Australian Stock Exchange last month, was two cents firmer at A$2.44 at 10.10 a.m. (0010 GMT).
